# Morsel

> Morsel is a small, self-hosted, API-first service for creating capability-protected Markdown shares and rendering them in a same-origin web viewer.

The public service is available at `https://morsel.narumi.dev/`. It supports GitHub Flavored Markdown, syntax-highlighted fenced code, KaTeX, Mermaid, and fenced `vega-lite` charts with inline data. Authored HTML is not executed, and Vega-Lite charts cannot load external resources.

Important usage notes:

- REST creation/revocation and every MCP request require an existing UI-managed Bearer API key checked in PostgreSQL. Keys can write only their own account's shares; an admin role does not bypass ownership. Cookies alone cannot authorize MCP; there is no OAuth. Use only custom-header-capable clients.
- `/mcp` provides stateless Streamable HTTP with normal JSON responses, no persistent sessions/session IDs, and no persistent SSE streams. Authenticated GET/DELETE return 405 with `Allow: POST`. The official Go SDK is pinned to v1.8.0; supported/tested protocol versions are `2025-11-25`, `2025-06-18`, and `2025-03-26`.
- MCP POST needs Bearer authorization even for initialization/discovery, JSON Content-Type, and `Accept: application/json, text/event-stream`. Subsequent requests need the negotiated `MCP-Protocol-Version`. Authority/Host must match `MORSEL_URL` after hostname-case/default-port normalization; use the configured localhost URL for direct development. Omitted Origin is allowed; a present Origin must be exactly the canonical configured origin. Duplicate, null, and foreign Origins are forbidden.
- `tools/list` publishes explicit MCP input/output schemas. `create_share` takes REST creation fields (`content`, optional `expires_in`, `max_views`, `preview`, `telegram_instant_view`); null expiration/view limits mean absent. `get_share` takes `{ "token": "RAW_CAPABILITY_TOKEN" }`, never a URL or UUID. `revoke_share` takes `{ "id": "ADMINISTRATIVE_SHARE_UUID" }` and succeeds with `{ "id": "...", "revoked": true }` only for the key's account; repeated owned revocation succeeds. There are no account, listing, or admin tools.
- Every successful REST `GET /v1/shares/{share}` or MCP `get_share` consumes exactly one view. A valid capability can read another account's share without owner identity. Never retrieve a newly created share to validate it. Retrieve only when explicitly requested; never automatically retry creation or retrieval.
- MCP results contain structured JSON plus matching JSON text. Tool failures use `isError: true` with safe `code`/`message`, distinct from HTTP authentication errors. Foreign/missing revocation IDs both use `not_found`; expired, revoked, and exhausted capability errors remain distinct. All MCP responses use `Cache-Control: no-store`; existing body/document/request time limits apply. A deadline before response commitment returns safe HTTP 504. Do not log payloads.
- An opt-in `GET /s/{capability}` Open Graph response does not consume a view, but it repeatedly exposes the explicit preview title and description, optional image URL and locale, and generated share URL; it must not be fetched without the user's request.
- Treat API keys, raw capability tokens, and complete share URLs as secrets. Do not expose or log them.
- Viewer URLs use `#/s/{capability}` when preview metadata is omitted. Shares created with required `preview.title` and `preview.description` and optional `preview.image` and `preview.locale` use `/s/{capability}` so link-preview crawlers can fetch metadata; a browser then sends the capability to the same-origin retrieval API.
- Retrieval responses must not be cached. Expired, revoked, and exhausted shares are unavailable.

## Documentation

- [Morsel documentation](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/narumiruna/morsel/main/README.md): Setup, API examples, retrieval semantics, configuration, operations, and security model.
- [MCP usage](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/narumiruna/morsel/main/docs/usage.md#mcp-clients): Custom-header configuration, local curl examples, tool effects, and secret handling. Production proxy and external-client acceptance require the deployment handoff; local tests do not establish them.
- [Morsel OpenAPI contract](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/narumiruna/morsel/main/packages/server/openapi.yaml): REST-only request, response, authentication, schema, and error definitions; MCP schemas come from authenticated `tools/list`.

## Optional

- [Morsel source repository](https://github.com/narumiruna/morsel): Go API, React viewer, deployment configuration, tests, and issue history.
